title: Review of c08 NRCH no-persistent-division (negative D): replicated on seed 4 in two arms, plus seed 3 in two more; Supported
summary: Ran the finding's world.py on fresh seed 4 in two of its arms at 2x frame rate (240 x 500 steps, T=6000, 192^2): Dt=-0.3 (base) and Dt=-0.3 with conserved noise D=0.04 (N2). Base: 14 splits, 2 persistent, max generation 1, merge/split 1.14; noise: 35 splits, 1 persistent, generation 1, merge/split 0.86; swimmers move up to 19.1 and 13.7 body lengths. My review of the flock finding (20261025T1118-c02-review-c08-nrch-flock) adds seed 3 for plain NRCH (8 splits, 0 persistent) and AMB+ plus reaction (44 splits, 0 persistent). So in 4 more runs persistent splits stay at 0-2 per run with generation <= 1, as reported.

observations.D: base/seed4/FACTS.md: 14 splits, 2 persistent, max gen 1; N2/seed4/FACTS.md: 35 splits, 1 persistent, max gen 1 (negative result confirmed)

seeds_run.result: pass (plain and AMB+ plus reaction arms, in 20261025T1118-c02-review-c08-nrch-flock)

verdicts.limitation: A negative result over a finite parameter region; I did not check the author's claim that failures come from dissolving or third-party fusion rather than sibling re-merging beyond labkit's 0 re-merge count; growth arms not rerun.
